name: code-atlas
description: Read-only CodeAtlas workflows for repository exploration, tracing, change analysis and maintainability decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Read-only graph-assisted workflows for understanding, tracing, changing and assessing code.
interface.longDescription: CodeAtlas is one private skill with four routed lanes: UNDERSTAND, TRACE, CHANGE and ASSESS. It uses a worktree-local CodeGraph index when available, negotiates visible MCP tools at runtime, defaults to codegraph_explore, and reports CLI-only or unavailable evidence honestly. It never edits code, creates issues or runs CodeGraph commands by itself.
defaultPrompt: Use CodeAtlas to understand this repository area.
Use CodeAtlas to trace this request or symbol.
Use CodeAtlas to assess maintainability before the next change.
